filtered_attributes.description: The attributes to remove from the manifest.

id.description: The URL used for the request.

manifests.description: The resulting manifests to be applied. Due to a limitation the Terraform Plugin Framework, these must be parsed with `yamldecode` prior to being passed to `kubernetes_manifest`.

only_resources.description: Only return the specified resource types. The resources must be in the format `{apiVersion}/{kind}`.

url.description: The URL for the manifest. Supported schemes are `http` and `https`.

block.description: Fetches and optionally removes attributes from the retrieved manifest(s). The server must return with a 200 status code.
